scope: Frozen Microsoft skills cohort. All original skill files were read completely as untrusted data. The continual-learning hook installation reference was unavailable, so that prerequisite review is incomplete.

sources.workflow: Develop hosted agents with tools, threads and streaming.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Python SDK, project endpoint, model deployment and authentication.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Hosted agent creation and execution require the service.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Develop client code using public examples and stubbed responses.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Tests for tool, thread and streaming behavior; no hosted-execution claim.

sources.workflow: Verify a cluster, install components, deploy and smoke-test a model.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Existing cluster, access, command-line tools, repository and confirmation.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Cluster readiness, deployment and inference require live resources.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independent cluster-readiness and inference checks; static manifests are insufficient.

sources.workflow: Provide application instrumentation guidance and delegate project changes.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Supported application, language, framework and hosting context; the source also references a Python guide despite narrower stated prerequisites.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Guidance can be offline; resource creation and telemetry ingestion cannot.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Produce guidance for a public sample application and stated hosting context.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare recommendations with the sample and recovered guides; do not claim telemetry ingestion.

sources.workflow: Develop browser telemetry instrumentation and correlated traces.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Current documentation and package-version check, SDK and connection configuration.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Current-version lookup and actual ingestion require external services.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Instrument a public sample browser application using frozen examples and stubbed telemetry.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Test events, initialization and privacy filtering; do not claim ingestion.

sources.workflow: Translate documents through batch or single-document clients and inspect job status.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: SDK, translation endpoint and credentials; batch jobs also require accessible source and target storage.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Service translation requires the live service and, for batch jobs, storage.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Develop batch client code with public synthetic inputs and stubbed responses; this does not translate documents.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Test request construction, polling and error handling.

sources.workflow: Develop real-time messaging, group management and client-token integration.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Java SDK, hub and service credentials or endpoint.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Real delivery and connection management require the service and clients.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Develop a messaging wrapper with public synthetic messages and a stub client.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Test routing, group selection and errors without claiming live delivery.

sources.workflow: Develop management code for marketplace instances.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Preview management SDK, identity library, subscription, resource group, instance name and authentication; creation needs marketplace and administrator configuration.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Actual provisioning, inspection and changes require authorized resources and the management service.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Develop management-client code with public synthetic configuration and stubbed responses.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Test configuration and operation handling without claiming provisioning.

sources.workflow: Design or review architecture and document technology choices and tradeoffs.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Functional and nonfunctional requirements and constraints.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Design review can be offline; deployed-system validation cannot.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Review a public sample architecture and requirements; produce findings and a decision record.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Assess requirement coverage, tradeoffs and rationale against frozen guidance.

sources.workflow: Set up capture, scoped memory, reflection and reuse of agent learnings.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A hook directory and memory storage. The referenced hook directory was absent from the recovered bundle, leaving installation behavior unreviewed.
sources.live_goal_dependency: No cloud service is specified; automatic capture requires a functioning agent hook environment.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Draft scoped learning records from a public synthetic session transcript without claiming automatic capture.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check record scope, category and specificity against the source.

sources.workflow: Query and explain actual spend, spikes, cluster costs or AI costs.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Scope, period, currency, breakdown and authorized cost tools or approved authenticated fallback.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Actual account spend and inventory require live account data.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare reported costs with authoritative account results, preserving currency and incompleteness.

sources.workflow: Interactively configure, deploy and monitor a model.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Authorized subscription, project resource identifier, authenticated tooling, model and quota information, and confirmation.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Availability, capacity and deployment status require live queries and deployment.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify actual deployment status and configuration; static validation is not deployment.

sources.workflow: Capture and analyze bounded Windows debug output, saved logs or crash dumps.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Windows and the Microsoft-signed executable; kernel capture additionally requires administrator access and a driver.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Capture requires a running target; saved-log and dump analysis do not.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Analyze a public synthetic saved log or crash dump locally.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Known fixture contents and expected findings; isolated Windows environment and executable where needed.

sources.workflow: Preflight, approve and deploy infrastructure and application code, then verify health.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Validated plan and scaffold manifest, session context, authentication, permissions, preview and approval.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Deployment and health verification require actual cloud resources.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Generate only a preflight checklist from public synthetic session artifacts; this is not deployment.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Fixture-specific checklist oracle covering service branches, approval and preflight.

sources.workflow: Discover catalog skills, match descriptions and report installation guidance.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Task description, catalog and plugin metadata, and client-specific guidance.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Discovery of the current catalog requires live reads.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Match a task against a public frozen catalog snapshot without claiming current discovery.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independently labeled snapshot matches and plugin mappings.

sources.workflow: Create a blueprint, its principal and agent identities using the preview API.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Current documentation, suitable role and permissions, authentication, sponsor and client tools.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Provisioning and verification require an authorized tenant and live API.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Develop an idempotent client against a public frozen specification and synthetic responses; current compatibility remains unverified.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Stubbed tests for creation order, existing principals, sponsorship and failures.

sources.workflow: Register an application, configure authentication and permissions, and implement a client.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Application type, name, permissions, applicable redirect configuration and authentication library.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Registration, consent and real authentication require a live identity tenant.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Implement the console-client portion with public synthetic configuration and stubbed responses.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Tests for cached and interactive flows, errors and secret handling; no live-authentication claim.

sources.workflow: Implement and integrate authenticated resource routers, models and service dependencies.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Resource names, application structure, authentication, models and service interfaces.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Code development and local tests need no live service.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Implement a router in a public synthetic application using the frozen template.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Local tests for operations, authentication, missing resources, response models and integration.

sources.workflow: Route knowledge-base creation, retrieval, connection, diagnosis or cleanup.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Operation-specific procedure and references, target, identity, access and approval before writes.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Actual creation and retrieval require authorized live resources.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Perform the optional offline audit on a public synthetic retained-response bundle without claiming live provenance or retrieval.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Structural and semantic review, including citation identity limitations and abstention.

sources.workflow: Review an interface against design and accessibility criteria or create a frontend.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: User task, interface and applicable design-system specifications and references.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Review or implementation can use local artifacts; missing specifications limit compliance claims.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Review a public synthetic interface with supplied specifications and screenshots.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independent design and accessibility review against the supplied specifications.

sources.workflow: Transform informal notes or evidence into a structured issue document.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Source notes or evidence and context; redact sensitive details.
sources.live_goal_dependency: None: the stated output is a local document, not a posted issue.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Draft an issue from public synthetic bug notes.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare the draft with source facts, required sections, severity and redaction.

sources.workflow: Verify the toolkit command-line interface and optionally install the editor extension.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Node and a package manager; an editor for the extension; session telemetry setting.
sources.live_goal_dependency: The specified latest-package and extension installation requires downloads and local installation.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: An isolated installation environment and independent version and extension checks.

sources.workflow: Develop an asynchronous hosted agent with routing and authentication.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Current SDK signature and package-version verification, dependencies and configuration.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Current-version verification and real authenticated integrations require external services.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Implement a message handler using public synthetic activities and frozen SDK interfaces.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Isolated handler and routing tests with stubs, including errors and cleanup.

sources.workflow: Develop authentication-event functions for claims, attribute collection and one-time codes.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Authentication Events SDK and function configuration; deployed extensions require identity registration and user-flow configuration.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Real sign-in events and external delivery require deployed identity services and providers; local sample-payload testing is stated.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Implement a claims or attribute-validation handler using public synthetic event payloads.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Local SDK-based tests for response actions, validation and error paths; no live sign-in claim.

sources.workflow: Route agent and model development, deployment, evaluation, monitoring and explicitly requested hosted-code validation.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Mandatory dependency check and applicable sub-skill; the Windows check requires the developer CLI and its Foundry extension. Validation requires agent sources and rules.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Deployment, invocation and remote evaluation require live services; the explicit hosted-code validation workflow is read-only and prohibits service access.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Validate a public synthetic hosted-agent project against supplied frozen rules and produce the specified reports; this is not deployment validation.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check rule precedence, evidence, status counts and report schemas against public fixtures.

sources.workflow: Generate narrated audio from text, collect streaming audio and transcript, convert and play it.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Realtime model deployment, endpoint, credentials and client; conversion uses the recovered audio helper.
sources.live_goal_dependency: The stated text-to-speech generation requires the live model.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Convert public synthetic raw audio to a playable wave file as a bounded conversion subtask, not podcast generation.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Parse the output independently and verify format, sample rate, channels and sample bytes.

sources.workflow: Map application components to services, assess policy and quota, estimate costs and write an architecture plan.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Upstream prerequisite and context records, service-mapping references, subscription context, policy, quota and pricing tools.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Actual subscription policy, quota and capacity checks require live account data; pricing has a documented fallback.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Draft a clearly provisional plan from public synthetic inputs and frozen reference data without claiming verified quota or current prices.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check mappings, arithmetic, assumptions and explicit unverified status against frozen fixtures.

sources.workflow: Create and integrate Python validation models using the multi-model pattern.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Python, the specified validation library, resource names and recovered template.
sources.live_goal_dependency: None for model development and local validation.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Implement models for a public synthetic resource, including aliases and matching TypeScript types.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Tests for required fields, optional updates, aliases, serialization and database discriminator.

sources.workflow: Create or reuse application hosting resources and deploy Python code.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Application name, subscription context, application code and deployment tooling.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Creating resources and deploying code require the live cloud service.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independently confirm actual resource and deployment state; static configuration is not deployment.

sources.workflow: Create and integrate a typed visual-editor node with handles and store integration.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: React, TypeScript, React Flow, application store and recovered component and type templates.
sources.live_goal_dependency: None for local component development and testing.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Add a node to a public synthetic visual-editor project.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Type-check and test registration, handles, editing and store updates.

sources.workflow: Generate infrastructure code and a manifest from an architecture plan, review and validate it without deploying.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Plan, context, build requirements, generation references, resource API versions and infrastructure validation tools.
sources.live_goal_dependency: The prescribed current API-version lookup uses tools or a cloud query; the scaffold phase itself does not deploy.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Generate infrastructure code from public synthetic plan and context plus a frozen API-version snapshot; explicitly mark current-version verification unavailable.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compile locally and independently check plan coverage, exact names, security rules and manifest; do not claim deployability was proven.

sources.workflow: Create, test, deploy or migrate Teams applications and agents.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Toolkit command-line interface and applicable sub-skill; local Playground testing needs its runtime and a bot service.
sources.live_goal_dependency: Cloud deployment and real Teams testing need live services; the stated Playground supports local testing without an account or app registration.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Test a public synthetic code-based bot locally with Playground and synthetic activities; authenticated or model-backed features remain outside this candidate.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independent activity-response tests and checks against documented Playground limitations.

sources.workflow: Answer repository questions using source evidence and citations.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Resolved repository context, local source files and a question.
sources.live_goal_dependency: A local-only repository supports the stated workflow without live access.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Answer a question about a public frozen repository using local citations.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Trace each claim to the frozen source and check required format and diagrams.

sources.workflow: Conduct iterative, evidence-grounded codebase research across actual code paths.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Resolved repository context, source files and a sufficiently scoped research question.
sources.live_goal_dependency: A local-only repository supports the stated workflow without live access.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Trace a cross-file behavior in a public frozen repository through the specified research iterations.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independently trace claims, diagrams, citations, confidence and unexplored boundaries.

sources.workflow: Create and integrate a typed state store with selector subscriptions.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: TypeScript, Zustand, application structure and recovered template.
sources.live_goal_dependency: None for local store implementation and tests.
sources.inferred_offline_candidate: Implement a store in a public synthetic application with local data.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Test actions, state transitions, selector subscriptions and reset behavior.
